title: Fans Begin Overnight Merch Line at Choctaw Stadium Ahead of Arlington Shows
detail: August 13, 2026 — ARMY start lining up as early as 10 p.m. Thursday outside Choctaw Stadium (the former Texas Rangers ballpark) in Arlington for official ARIRANG World Tour merchandise, ahead of BTS's two-night AT&T Stadium run (Aug 15-16). By 11 a.m. Friday the line had wrapped around the stadium; the merch pre-order line reportedly filled within minutes. Fans traveled from as far as Nebraska (a 9-hour drive), Alabama, and Odessa, Texas, relying on umbrellas, folding chairs, and water to cope with the Texas heat ahead of forecast highs of 101°F for both show days.

media.caption: ARMY fans line up overnight outside Choctaw Stadium in Arlington for official ARIRANG merchandise ahead of BTS's AT&T Stadium shows.

title: J-Hope, RM Draw Backlash for Attending Chris Brown's Toronto Concert
detail: August 13, 2026 — J-Hope and RM attended the second of two Toronto stops on Chris Brown and Usher's co-headlining 'R&B Tour' at Rogers Stadium, days before BTS's own two-night Rogers Stadium run (Aug 22-23). Photos posted to Brown's Instagram showed the pair posing with him, and fan videos captured them dancing and singing along to his song 'Look at Me Now.' The appearance drew swift backlash from segments of the ARMY fanbase, who cited Brown's 2009 felony assault conviction involving Rihanna and his July 2026 guilty plea over a 2023 nightclub attack in London ('It's so sad and very disappointing to see them associating themselves with an abuser'); other fans defended the pair, noting they may have attended primarily for Usher and cautioning against snap moral judgments based on one night. Neither J-Hope, RM, nor HYBE issued a formal response.

media.caption: J-Hope and RM attend Chris Brown and Usher's Toronto concert, sparking fan debate.
